info.title: MPC Auth Management API
info.description: Distributed Auth / MPC node HTTP API. All responses use node.APIResponse (code, error, data). Keygen and sign GET/list response bodies include effectiveEcdsaMpcProtocol for secp256k1 ("gg18" or "cggmp24"); empty when not applicable. For completed secp256k1 keys, GET /getKeyGenResultById data and GET /getAllGroupIds keyGens[] include ethereumaddress plus bitcoinp2wpkhmainnet (bc1… mainnet), bitcoinp2wpkhtestnet (Bitcoin TestNet3 tb1…), bitcoinp2wpkhsignet (Bitcoin Signet; btcd SigNet witness HRP tb so encoding may duplicate testnet). GET /getGlobalNonceByKeyGenId data map includes effectiveEcdsaMpcProtocol (see that path description). See mpc-config docs/references/API_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

node.EffectiveEcdsaMpcProtocol.description: Runtime secp256k1 ECDSA MPC variant for this key/request: "gg18" or "cggmp24". Empty for non-secp256k1 keys. API-only (JSON); stored request field remains ecdsaMpcProtocol on the keygen payload. Returned on keygen/sign GET and list responses and on GET /getGlobalNonceByKeyGenId data.

node.KeyGenResultData.description: Documentary shape for APIResponse.data from GET /getKeyGenResultById when Code=0 (actual payloads also include protobuf keygenrequestdatapb, savedata ciphertext, possibly cggmp24aux; optional fields omitted when empty). For secp256k1 MPC keys with pubkeyhex, ethereumaddress plus bitcoin SegWit v0 P2WPKH strings are recomputed server-side.

pubkeyhex.description: MPC joint pubkey as x‖y uncompressed coordinates, 128 hex characters

ethereumaddress.description: EVM-style address derived from pubkeyhex when keytype is secp256k1

bitcoinp2wpkhmainnet.description: Bitcoin mainnet native SegWit v0 (P2WPKH) bc1… from pubkeyhex

bitcoinp2wpkhsignet.description: Bitcoin Signet P2WPKH (chaincfg.SigNetParams; witness HRP is tb per btcd — may match bitcoinp2wpkhtestnet string for the same pubkey)

nodeKey.description: Optional (recommended). 128-hex MPC node id from GET /getNodeKey — include in the signed JSON with nonce/sig so the signature cannot be replayed on another node. Omitting nodeKey is deprecated and may become unsupported.

ecdsaMpcProtocol.description: Optional. secp256k1 only — MPC ECDSA variant for this key ("gg18" or omit = GG18 DKG; "cggmp24" = CGGMP24 path when implemented). Ignored for ed25519. Invalid non-empty values are rejected for secp256k1. Must be included in the management-key signed JSON when sent.

nodeKey.description: Optional (recommended). 128-hex MPC node id from GET /getNodeKey — include in the signed JSON with nonce/sig so the signature cannot be replayed on another node. Omitting nodeKey is deprecated and may become unsupported.

threshold.description: Interpretation depends on ECDSA MPC mode (see ecdsaMpcProtocol) and key type. GG18 (secp256k1 default / omit) and Ed25519: Shamir polynomial degree d; MPC signing needs d+1 parties; require d strictly less than n (n = group size). CGGMP24 (secp256k1 with ecdsaMpcProtocol "cggmp24"): literal signing quorum t; MPC signing needs t parties; require 2 ≤ t ≤ n.

nodeKey.description: Optional (recommended). 128-hex MPC node id from GET /getNodeKey — include in the signed JSON with nonce/sig so the signature cannot be replayed on another node. Omitting nodeKey is deprecated and may become unsupported.

publicKeys.description: New array of public keys (must include at least one)

relayerPublicKey.description: Public key used to sign this request

signedMessage.description: Exact string signed (MetaMask or Ed25519). If JSON, SHOULD include "nodeKey" (128 hex from GET /getNodeKey) so the client signature binds to this node; omitting nodeKey in JSON is deprecated.

nodeKey.description: Optional; when using Ed25519 with an empty signedMessage, include in JSON so canonical signing includes it (see API_IMPLEMENTATION.md). For MetaMask, embed "nodeKey" inside the JSON you place in signedMessage.

clientSig.description: signed by clientpk saved when keygen

presignId.description: presignId of presign, instead of requestId of presign

sourceChainID.description: Chain ID of the source transaction

sourceTxHash.description: NEW: Source transaction information for pre-signing verification

destinationChainID.description: Destination chain ID (stored and returned in listSignRequests / getSignRequestById)

destinationAddress.description: Destination address (stored and returned in listSignRequests / getSignRequestById)

extraJSON.description: Arbitrary JSON string for node context (stored and returned in listSignRequests / getSignRequestById)

sig.description: Management signature over the JSON body with sig set to empty

nodeKey.description: Optional (recommended). 128-hex MPC node id from GET /getNodeKey — include in the signed JSON with Nonce/sig so the signature cannot be replayed on another node. Omitting nodeKey is deprecated and may become unsupported.

txParams.description: Single-tx execute params, or batch index 0 when txParamsBatch omitted (see API_IMPLEMENTATION.md)

txParamsBatch.description: Batch only: length N; merges per index with proposal_tx_params into execute_tx_params (mutually exclusive with txParams)

messageHash.description: Single-tx: unsigned EVM tx signing hash (hex); local only, not propagated

messageHashes.description: Batch only: optional length-N digest list; replaces agreed hashes on originator; empty string at index i skips that leg; at least one non-empty required

messageRawBatch.description: Batch only: optional; length must match messageHashes when both sent

nonce.description: Management key nonce (see GET /getNodeMgtKeyNonce or /getPublicMgtKeyNonce for Ed25519)

chainId.description: Chain id (number or string in JSON; stored as string)

baseFee.description: EIP-1559 base fee (gwei); omit or null to leave unset for client refetch

priorityFee.description: EIP-1559 priority fee (gwei); omit or null to leave unset for client refetch

baseFeeMultiplier.description: EIP-1559: percentage for base component of maxFeePerGas (e.g. 200 = 2× base); should be ≥ 100

defaultGetSigFeeSpeed.description: Optional. Default Get Sig / Get Sigs fee tier (eth_feeHistory-based): slow, normal, or fast. Omitted = leave unset; clients default to normal.

signedMessage.description: Exact string signed (MetaMask personal_sign or Ed25519). If you use a JSON payload, include "nodeKey" set to this node's 128-hex MPC public key (GET /getNodeKey) so the signature cannot be replayed on another node; omitting nodeKey in JSON is deprecated. Not applicable when signedMessage is opaque non-JSON (e.g. some MQTT CA flows).

node.LocalChainConfigDoc.description: Local chain config returned in GET /getChainDetails `data` (one object) or as elements of the array when listing all chains.

priorityFee.description: Optional; may be null if not stored

defaultGetSigFeeSpeed.description: Optional. slow | normal | fast. Omitted on legacy stored configs; clients default to normal.

Sig.description: Management signature over canonical JSON with Sig cleared

nodeKey.description: Optional: this node's MPC public key (hex); binds the signature to this node
